content.comment_body: In the timer function "Edge triggered wiping relay," there is an internal variable called "Pulse width (TH) Remaining" or "Off Time (TK) Remaining Time." This variable tracks the countdown until the timer completes its cycle. I can display this value in message texts on the device miniscreen, but I want to show the countdown on the web page, as it serves as a queue. How can I reference this internal variable to make it visible on the [product_name] Web Editor web page?

Within Tools > Parameter VM Mapping, select the relevant parameter from the block and assign an address, such as VW0. This action transfers the value to the VM area, allowing variable memory for data exchange with other [product_name] devices, controllers, or applications. In the [product_name] Web Editor, add the "Scale Time" block to the appropriate page, then configure its parameters under scale time properties. Please refer to the attachment.
Thank you for the help! It worked well in my test setup, and now I’m ready to apply it to my main project.
